name: publish_worksheet
description: Validate a lani.worksheet/v0 sheet of homework for a unit of the school's course and publish it to the app: it shows in the unit under "📝 Domača naloga · Homework", the newest first (companion/COURSE.md). unit: a unit of the course that isn't planned (get_course); id: kebab-case, not one of the unit's own worksheets (publishing the same id again replaces it); exercises: 1–8, the module types and the school's gaptext, table, transform, sort. Returns validation errors instead of publishing if invalid. Load the lani-studio skill before using. Say the learner {learner} and what agrees with them {m:…|f:…} (companion/SCENES.md, the learner in the content).
